notes.title: Class Update Available Now!
notes.content:
War has evolved. And so have you.

The latest Star Legion update introduces the long-awaited Class System! Players can now choose between three unique combat roles:

🔫 Assault – Great for direct and aggressive engagements. 🛡️ Heavy – Tougher and stronger, perfect for holding the front. 🎯 Recon – Fast and precise, ideal for flanking and stealth.

Each class comes with its own loadout, including primary and secondary weapons and visual customization.

✅ Share equipment between classes 🛠️ Unlock new weapons and appearances 🤝 Team up and tackle missions with a diverse squad
